tokens.name: ds-bg
tokens.usage: The page ground on every screen, the sticky bar, sheets and the Buy/Sell footer. Also the html/body background, because iOS paints the status bar from it.

tokens.name: ds-subtle
tokens.usage: Recessed fills: text fields, filter chips, option tiles, the close button, row press/hover highlight, and the 6px band between page sections.

tokens.name: ds-text
tokens.usage: Primary ink: titles, row names, every money figure. On ds-bg and ds-subtle (15.9:1 and 15.1:1 light; 15.9:1 and 14.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: ds-secondary
tokens.usage: Labels and supporting copy: hero labels, row meta, field labels, sheet notices, the quiet icon button. On ds-bg (5.0:1 light, 7.4:1 dark) and ds-subtle (4.7:1 light).

tokens.name: ds-muted
tokens.usage: The quietest ink: section meta, result counts, list footers, placeholders, row chevrons, a clipped account name. FLAG: 2.8:1 on ds-bg in light and 4.4:1 in dark, below 4.5:1 for normal text; keep it to non-essential captions or darken it.

tokens.name: ds-line
tokens.usage: Every hairline: row dividers, the sticky bar's bottom edge, field and chip borders, the grabber, a chosen chart range's pill. Decorative only (1.2:1); never the only cue for a state.

tokens.name: ds-accent
tokens.usage: Interactive ink: Back links, text actions (Clear all, Add currency), icon-button glyphs, an active chip's border and text, the price line, the Buy kind icon. On ds-bg 5.6:1 light, 7.4:1 dark; on ds-accent-tint 5.0:1 / 5.6:1.

tokens.name: ds-accent-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind accent ink: the icon button, secondary buttons (Sell), an active filter chip or option, the cash account glyph, the Buy kind icon well.

tokens.name: ds-positive
tokens.usage: Gains only (a return, a day's rise) and the Deposit kind icon. On ds-bg 5.9:1 light, 9.8:1 dark; on ds-positive-bg 5.4:1 / 7.7:1.

tokens.name: ds-negative
tokens.usage: Losses and form errors only. Never a Sell or a Withdraw: money leaving is not a loss. On ds-bg 5.6:1 light, 8.2:1 dark; on ds-negative-bg 5.1:1 / 6.7:1.

tokens.name: ds-positive-bg
tokens.usage: The tint under a positive return percentage (the return pill) and the Deposit icon well.

tokens.name: ds-negative-bg
tokens.usage: The tint under a negative return percentage.

tokens.name: ds-action
tokens.usage: The filled primary button (Save, Buy, Show N records). Not ds-accent: dark mode lightens the accent for text, but the filled button stays a saturated cobalt under white ink.

tokens.name: ds-action-ink
tokens.usage: Text on ds-action. 5.6:1 light; FLAG 4.5:1 is missed slightly in dark (4.47:1) at the 15.6px button size.

tokens.name: ds-focus
tokens.usage: The 3px keyboard focus outline, offset 3px, on buttons, links and fields. FLAG: 2.8:1 on ds-bg in light, below 3:1 for a focus ring; 6.5:1 in dark.

tokens.name: ds-cash
tokens.usage: Cash wherever it is charted (the breakdown bar, its weight ring). The neutral slate: cash is money not invested, so it wears neither the accent nor the gain green.

tokens.name: ds-hold-1
tokens.usage: Breakdown hue for the largest holding by value (bar segment, weight ring, legend dot). Assigned by rank, never by asset type. Marks only; always beside a label.

tokens.name: ds-hold-2
tokens.usage: Breakdown hue for the 2nd holding by value.

tokens.name: ds-hold-3
tokens.usage: Breakdown hue for the 3rd holding by value.

tokens.name: ds-hold-4
tokens.usage: Breakdown hue for the 4th holding by value.

tokens.name: ds-hold-5
tokens.usage: Breakdown hue for the 5th holding by value.

tokens.name: ds-hold-other
tokens.usage: Every holding past the fifth: a quiet neutral, never a recycled hue.

tokens.name: ds-sell
tokens.usage: The Sell kind icon glyph. Its own quiet hue so a sale never reads as a loss. Icon on ds-sell-bg: 4.2:1 light, 6.6:1 dark.

tokens.name: ds-sell-bg
tokens.usage: The Sell kind icon well.

tokens.name: ds-withdraw
tokens.usage: The Withdraw kind icon glyph. Icon on ds-withdraw-bg: 4.4:1 light, 7.1:1 dark.

tokens.name: ds-withdraw-bg
tokens.usage: The Withdraw kind icon well.

tokens.name: ds-indicator
tokens.usage: The 200-day moving average line on the holding chart, and its toggle chip's swatch when on.

tokens.name: ds-band-5
tokens.usage: The ±5% band around the 200-day average (1px line, 3:1 for lines).

tokens.name: ds-band-10
tokens.usage: The ±10% band around the 200-day average.

tokens.name: ds-band-15
tokens.usage: The ±15% band around the 200-day average.

tokens.name: ion-tab-bar-background
tokens.usage: Tab bar ground. First-system token (theme/variables.css): the tab bar has not moved to ds-* yet.

tokens.name: ion-tab-bar-color
tokens.usage: Idle tab icon and label (3.1:1 light, 3.0:1 dark on the tab bar). First-system token.

tokens.name: ion-tab-bar-color-selected
tokens.usage: Selected tab icon and label. Idle and selected differ by ink, not weight. First-system token.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The selected tab's 20×2px marker on the bar's top edge, the only place it appears on a migrated screen. First-system token.

tokens.name: ion-border-color
tokens.usage: The tab bar's top hairline. First-system token.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: The page heading on every screen, tab root or pushed: --ds-fs-23. Account names use line-height 1.25.

styles.name: form-title
styles.usage: The question on a full-screen task (new account): --ds-fs-23 at 600.

styles.name: empty-title
styles.usage: An empty state's headline: --ds-fs-22.

styles.name: sheet-title
styles.usage: A bottom sheet's title, left of the close button: --ds-fs-18.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: A section's h2 under the 6px band: --ds-fs-16.

styles.name: bar-title
styles.usage: The centred title in the sticky bar and a pushed page's Back bar: --ds-fs-16.

styles.name: task-bar-title
styles.usage: The centred title of a full-screen task's top bar: --ds-fs-13.

styles.name: tab-label
styles.usage: Tab bar labels, uppercase. Fixed px, not scaled. First-system style.

styles.name: hero-figure
styles.usage: A screen's one headline amount (portfolio, holding, account, a transaction in its sheet): --ds-fs-27. On a narrow screen an account total caps at 9vw and wraps.

styles.name: metric-figure
styles.usage: Figures in a two-column metric grid (Investments / Cash, a holding's position): --ds-fs-13.

styles.name: row-figure
styles.usage: A holding row's value: --ds-fs-12.

styles.name: ledger-figure
styles.usage: A transaction or account row's amount: --ds-fs-11.

styles.name: return-pill
styles.usage: A return percentage on its tint, and option counts: --ds-fs-10.

styles.name: row-return
styles.usage: A holding row's return line under its value: --ds-fs-9.

styles.name: back-link
styles.usage: The Back control: the tab's name in ds-accent, after a 22px chevron: --ds-fs-15.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Full-width actions: --ds-fs-13. The Buy/Sell footer uses 16.8px (--ds-fs-14).

styles.name: row-title
styles.usage: A list row's name: --ds-fs-12.

styles.name: hero-label
styles.usage: The label above a hero figure, and a field's text: --ds-fs-12, ds-secondary.

styles.name: body-help
styles.sample: Set the current balance, not the amount of a deposit.
styles.usage: Sheet notices, empty-state copy, field labels, form errors: --ds-fs-11 (labels at line-height normal).

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Section meta (ds-muted), date headings (500, ds-secondary), chip values: --ds-fs-10.

styles.name: row-meta
styles.usage: A row's second line, list footers, filter labels: --ds-fs-9.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase group labels (filter heading in ds-muted, a task's kicker in ds-accent): --ds-fs-9.

styles.name: fine-print
styles.usage: The account under a ledger amount, the one thing on a row allowed to clip: --ds-fs-8, ds-muted.

spacing.note: The source defines one spacing token. Every other gap is a literal px value per component; see the README's spacing table.

tokens.name: ds-gutter
tokens.usage: The side inset of every screen and sheet: headings, sections, rows, the Buy/Sell footer. Rows bleed their press highlight 10px into it while their content stays on the text edge.
